result:
I changed the hold year dropdown so it always includes the year already saved on the hold, even when it falls outside the configured range. Nothing was run or tested, including the nested form on the enrollment screens.

- **Cause:** the dropdown only lists years inside the configured year/semester range, which defaults to 5 years back and 1 forward. An older hold's year wasn't in the list, so the dropdown came up blank.
- **`app/models/year_semester.rb`:** `YearSemester.selectable_years` now accepts extra years. It merges them into the range, removes duplicates and sorts. The reverse order still applies afterwards when the range is configured that way.
- **`app/helpers/enrollment_holds_helper.rb`:** new `year_form_column` passes the record's year to `selectable_years`, so editing an old hold shows and keeps its year.

Hold dates older than the range still can't be chosen on a new hold; the only way to widen the range is the `year_semester_range` custom variable.

The nested enrollment form should pick up this helper, since the screens share the hold form. That's the part I didn't check.
